Express Union NEXT

A proposed next generation of Express Union, the Cameroonian money-transfer and microfinance network: one account to send to any Express Union, MTN or Orange number, an Express Union number on WhatsApp, Telegram and SMS, an agent that never moves money without the PIN, contactless NFC payments, community money and a developer API, with a user guide and a book readable online.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Express Union built one of the best-known money-transfer networks in Cameroon on agencies and trust. Many customers now move money by phone and live in their chats, while sending between networks, paying a merchant or saving in a tontine still often means queues, cash and no record. The founder asked for a picture of what comes next.

02

What it does

One account opens four doors: the app, an Express Union number on WhatsApp, Telegram and SMS for people who will not install an app, the agency, and an API. Customers send to any Express Union, MTN or Orange number with the name checked first, pay bills and merchants, add money from mobile money, pay or receive by tapping phones (NFC) and collect cash with a code; a merchant's own phone can become a Tap to Phone terminal. A personal agent prepares recurring tasks and a virtual receptionist answers questions and books appointments, but nothing moves without the customer's PIN. Community money covers tontines, collections, group gifts, paid groups, payment pages for creators and verified help requests. Merchant, agency and administration consoles and a developer sandbox complete the demo, with a guided presentation for the founder, a user guide and a book that explains why the project matters, both read online in the app.

03

How it is built

React and TypeScript with Vite and Tailwind, hosted on Vercel. A double-entry ledger runs in the browser in whole francs, never floating point, with idempotent commands, reversals, daily ceilings by verification level, salted PIN hashes and a lock after three wrong attempts. MTN, Orange, WhatsApp, Telegram and SMS are simulated, and agency details are shown only when verified. Contactless runs on a 60-second PIN-armed authorization; reading and writing NFC stickers uses Web NFC on Chrome for Android, the rest of the NFC exchange is simulated. The guide and the book were written from the code and from public sources and are read in a built-in reader, with real screens from the app.
